newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MacroAsia seeks one bln peso capital hike.
newsitem.headline: MacroAsia seeks one bln peso capital hike.

text.p: MacroAsia Corp, a subsidiary of Philippine Airlines, said on Friday its board had approved an increase in its authorised capital stock to two billion pesos from one billion.
The board also agreed to include airport services and mining related activities as the company's secondary purposes.
Last March, PAL announced its purchase of 70 percent of MacroAsia, an inflight catering firm, raising talks that the airline was seeking a backdoor listing.
Backdoor listing refers to companies taking over listed firms and gaining access to the stock market without the cumbersome requirements of a new listing.
